sources: https://www.camplife.com/398/reservation/step1 (CampLife booking API: reservation session, park record and site records for campground 398, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Free; campsites must be reserved through the District's reservation system.

fees.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/ ('Use of District lands is free of charge but we gladly accept donations') + https://nwfwater.com/content/download/18013/121907/Cotton%20Lake%20-%20brochure-flyer%201-27-20.pdf ('For a free reservation please visit our reservation site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Free permit booked through the District's CampLife reservation system (a free account is needed, and availability shows only once logged in). Up to 7 nights per reservation; no more than two reservations at a time or in a 30-day period. Arrive after 3 p.m., depart by 1 p.m. Each site holds up to eight people and two vehicles.

booking.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/escambia-river/cotton-lake-recreation-area/ ('seven reservation-only campsites', 'Campers may arrive after 3 p.m. and must depart by 1 p.m. on the final day of their reservation', 'Each campsite can hold a maximum of eight people and two vehicles') + https://nwfwater.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Step-by-Step-Instructions-on-How-to-Make-A-Camping-Reservation.pdf ('A reservation can be made for up to seven (7) nights'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/escambia-river/cotton-lake-recreation-area/ ('While campsites 1 through 4 are accessible to RVs, trailers, and tents, no power, water, or waste disposal hookups are available.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 1-4 take RVs, trailers and tents (CampLife: back-in, motorhomes accepted); 5-7 are tent-only and separate from the first four. CampLife lists every site as 50 x 50 ft, which looks like a default rather than a measured length, so no max rig length is recorded.

sites.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/escambia-river/cotton-lake-recreation-area/ ('Campsites 5 through 7 are tent-only sites and are separated from the first four sites') + CampLife session for campground 398 (site type 'Back-in' with MOTORHOME among its equipment), read 2026-10-21

note: NWFWMD campground on the Escambia River (Cotton Lake oxbow) in the Escambia River WMA near Molino, about 30 miles north of Pensacola off US-29. Picnic tables, pedestal grills, fire rings, portable toilet, boat ramp; maintained dirt/gravel access. Alcohol prohibited. Confirm a 23-ft rig fits sites 1-4 on arrival. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the District page, brochure and CampLife: 7 reservation-only sites (1-4 for RVs, motorhomes accepted), no hookups, free. Added fcfs never, 7-night limit, check-in/out times and the park's own CampLife booking link. No storm-closure banner on this site's page or the closures list. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: max rig length, season.
flags: Website line 2 is CampLife's district-wide listing (camplife.com/campground/Northwest+Florida+Water+Management+District); the District page's 'Reserve A Site' link for this campground is https://www.camplife.com/398/reservation/step1 (recorded in booking.url).
